verdict.rationale: Superset is agent-agnostic. Its docs say it can run Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, or "any CLI agent", so you choose the model indirectly by choosing which agent CLI to run. The evidence never says how LLM credentials or model selection are handled, such as Superset using your own API keys or letting you pick a specific model per agent. Missing for 10: explicit BYO API key/LLM documentation, per-agent model selection settings, independent confirmation that agents run on user-supplied credentials.
